name: workflows
description: Named webhooks the owner saves ("add webhook backup http://localhost:5678/webhook/backup") and runs by name ("run backup workflow"): n8n workflows, Home Assistant automations, Make/Zapier - anything a webhook starts. Asks before every run; list and delete. Local hosts only unless a host is added to scope.net.
route: run, add, list or delete a named webhook workflow (n8n, Home Assistant automation, Zapier)
